svg.title: AutoShade architecture: three front ends over one Rust library holding RAW decode, the AI advisor, the recipe, the render engine, the style index, reverse-fit, the local producers and the local-field analyzer; five local Python sidecars below it; two opt-in external AI services above it

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: AutoShade — the architecture, drawn from its own source

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 20 components (2 external, 3 frontend, 12 backend, 3 database) · 19 connections · 3 boundaries, all read from docs/architecture/autoshade.architecture.json
